prompt: We have one 24 GiB GPU serving an LLM, 20 internal users, bursty arrivals, and requests ranging from 500 to 16000 input tokens. During bursts, requests time out and GPU memory sometimes runs out. Propose the smallest practical design change and a debugging plan. Cover admission control, bounded queues, cancellation, prompt versus decode work, and metrics that distinguish the bottlenecks. State what you cannot conclude without measurements. Stay under 400 words; do not invent throughput numbers or immediately recommend another GPU.
review: Assess actionable diagnosis, token-aware memory/concurrency bounds, bounded waiting, cancellation cleanup, separate TTFT/decode/prefill metrics, and explicit uncertainty. This is a qualitative review, not a benchmark score.
